NOT written in-project, as this row said until 10 Oct. It derives from a pasted chat/notebook-tool answer summarising the degree-symbol authors Charubel, Sepharial, Kozminsky, Janduz, Muir, Henson, Weber and Matthews, kept at reference/degrees. Measured: 181 of 360 entries (Virgo 20 to Pisces 30) are that answer word for word with its citation marks removed, 8 more nearly so; 165 (Aries 1 to Virgo 19) are rewritten from it in the project's own sentences with the authors' names dropped; 6 Aries degrees have no counterpart. How close the answer is to the books is NOT known - reference/degrees/README.md

the symbol lines are the Jones/Wheeler symbols of 1925 (public domain); who wrote the summary keynotes is NOT known, and they read like Rudhyar 1973 - PROVENANCE.md item 2, the highest-risk question in the corpus
